facts.business: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited is a global automotive component manufacturer with business portfolio including Wiring Harness, Vision Systems, Modules & Polymer Products, Integrated Assemblies, and Emerging Businesses.

capacity_or_capex.item: MECPL third green field project - land, building, plant & machinery, working capital and pre-operating expenses

guidance_or_targets.statement: MECPL plans to achieve significant capacity expansion and margin improvements, including through backward integration
Green field project(s) to be funded with debt-equity ratio of 70:30

facts.related_party_note: Company proposes to provide loans/ICDs up to INR 3,000 million in FY 2026-27 and corporate guarantees up to INR 26,100 million in FY 2026-27 and INR 12,000 million in FY 2027-28 to Motherson Electronic Components Private Limited (MECPL). Interest rate for loans/ICDs at RBI Repo Rate plus 3% margin (effective 8.25% p.a. as on March 31, 2026). Corporate guarantee commission at 1% per annum. As on March 31, 2026, SMISL has invested INR 11,250 million in equity of MECPL and subsidiary(ies) have loans of INR 2,800 million to MECPL. Shareholders approved corporate guarantees up to INR 21,500 million at AGM on August 29, 2024, of which INR 16,000 million already issued.
